2610.09247.title: An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning
2610.09247.paper_summary: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.
2610.09247.paper_summary_zh: 學習目標達成策略的困難通常歸因於一種「地平線詛咒」，這種詛咒表現為時間差備份中的偏差累積和噪聲優勢估計。在這項工作中，我們識別出在目標條件策略學習中存在一種額外的信息性地平線詛咒，增加目標重新標記的地平線會顯著降低策略的泛化能力和性能。通過一系列與預言規劃者的受控實驗，我們將訓練期間採樣的目標地平線與在測試時要求策略達成的目標地平線解耦。即使僅在一系列相近的子目標上進行評估，目標條件行為克隆（BC）策略也會遭受嚴重的、依賴於訓練地平線的性能下降，而這種下降是可以通過強化學習（RL）目標來緩解的。我們將這一現象解釋為動作與事後重新標記的目標之間的條件互信息隨地平線的變化而減少，並實證發現，無論是BC還是RL策略，在長地平線目標上訓練時，其敏感性從目標信息轉向狀態信息，這一點可以通過策略的輸入雅可比矩陣來衡量。受到這一觀察的啟發，我們發現將短地平線策略的輸入雅可比矩陣提煉到長地平線策略中會產生顯著的性能提升，特別是在組合操作任務中。綜合來看，我們的結果突顯了在從離線數據學習通用策略時，目標重新標記地平線是一個重要的考量。
